steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: Notes from a meeting
steps.body: Two colleagues check what was decided and what remains a proposal.

examples.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a été décidé au sujet de l'horaire ?
examples.en: Mina: What was decided about the schedule?

examples.fr: La responsable a précisé que l'essai commencerait en juin.
examples.en: Luc: The coordinator clarified that the trial would start in June.
Mina: Did she confirm the new schedule?

examples.fr: Non. Elle a dit que le groupe devait d'abord vérifier les disponibilités.
examples.en: Luc: No. She said the group first needed to check availability.

examples.fr: Alors, je vais écrire que la date est prévue, mais pas définitive.
examples.en: Mina: Then I will write that the date is planned but not final.

steps.title: Checking a rumour
steps.body: A friend asks whether a shared message is confirmed.

examples.fr: J'ai entendu dire que le centre fermerait le vendredi.
examples.en: Sam: I heard that the centre might close on Friday.

examples.fr: Je ne sais pas. Le message ne donne aucune source.
examples.en: Sam: I don't know. The message gives no source.

examples.fr: La coordonnatrice a dit que rien n'était décidé.
examples.en: Awa: The coordinator said nothing had been decided.

examples.fr: D'accord, je ne transmettrai pas la rumeur comme un fait.
examples.en: Sam: Okay, I will not pass the rumour along as a fact.
